text_block_list.text:
Unable to shake off her disappointment,
Narita
Brian is having difficulties
applying herself to
training  ever since
she missed the chance to race
against
Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I take it upon myself to ask Symboli
Rudolf for a
scrimmage, and we set up a
match.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the result—Нарита Брайан loses by a
neck.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she sees a much bigger gap in
their
abilities and attributes the defeat
to her
overconfidence. The two of us
accept the loss and
use it as fuel to
improve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Нарита Брайан officially
challenges
Симболи Рудольф, and word of
this shocking
development spreads
throughout the school.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
